frontmatter.title: Automating Algorithm Discovery: A Case Study in Multi-Cloud Data Transfer
frontmatter.author: Shu Liu, Shubham Agarwal, Audrey Cheng, Ion Stoica, ADRS Team
frontmatter.excerpt: This post is the eleventh in our ADRS series. We tackle the challenge of efficiently accessing data across multiple cloud providers and regions, previously addressed by Cloudcast. By leveraging ADRS to evolve scheduling policies, we discover novel algorithms that minimize latency and cost when accessing data from different clouds.
